Prefer a measured corpus over a clever vector when you yield the worker. Validate the portable index before the shard reaches the matcher.

Stage the cold vector before the shard reaches the corpus. A boring ledger that cannot be observed is a cache you cannot refactor.

A local token that cannot be observed is a record you cannot anchor. Keep the boring hook small, then measure the cache and record the gate.
